protocol.policy: single-source cross-domain: train and select on one source domain, then evaluate each of the other three domains separately with no adaptation

fold_membership.train: the source domain's budgeted stage-2 train partition
fold_membership.val: the source domain's budgeted stage-2 val partition
fold_membership.tests: each other domain's budgeted stage-2 test partition, scored separately

protocol.source_test_rationale: Every sample keeps one project-wide role. The source domain's locked test partition is excluded rather than repurposed for training or validation, and target-domain validation images never influence checkpoint selection.
protocol.target_test_rationale: Each unseen target is capped to the common 50-image budget and reported separately, so target sample count is fixed without pooling acquisition domains or HD95 coordinate frames.

drishti_gs.note: provider_partition locks the 51-image provider test set and splits the 50-image provider training partition into 40 train / 10 val; test_fraction does not apply.

rim_one_dl.note: load_rim_one_dl_split_manifest is authoritative; the committed 70/10/20 manifest fixes membership and no fraction or seed in this file affects it.
